messages:
Priya S.: Proposed change: standardize SIEM export retention by environment - dev/staging 90d, prod 365d. Want signoff from security + legal before rolling.
Alex K.: Fine w/ that. Quick check: will dev still contain raw payloads for debug or only scrubbed artifacts?
Priya S.: Plan: raw stored in temp-raw for 7d then move to encrypted archive subject to env retention. Dev archives expire at 90d.
Marcus L.: Note: downstream partners use CMK-wrapped artifacts. Shorter prod retention means we must ensure old wrapped data remains decryptable for forensics until retention end; need key-rotation compatibility and export metadata.
Samir P.: For forensics/legal-holds we need a snapshot + freeze flow: admin creates hold, snapshot exported to hold-bucket, grant short-lived unwrap rights. All unwraps logged immutably.
Legal Team: Please add a legal-hold section with trigger criteria, approvers, and release steps. Also include who owns the hold.
Alex K.: RBAC proposal: add role `siem_export_reader` to read scrubbed exports, and `forensics_unwrap` for decrypting. Forensics role requires manager approval and 2FA.
Marcus L.: IAM condition suggestion: require kms:EncryptionContext/project=forensics and approval=true for decrypt. Also enforce short-lived grants rather than persistent key policy changes.
security-bot: Auto-note: SIEM exporter SA currently has decrypt on CMK siem-export-key-v1; last modified 2025-11-03.
Priya S.: Action items: 1) I'll update RFC with retention matrix + legal-hold flow; 2) Alex to open RBAC PR; 3) Marcus to outline KMS grant flow; 4) Samir to update IR runbooks.
Alex K.: Opening PR-8012 with policy examples.
Marcus L.: Will prototype orchestration that issues ticket-scoped KMS grants and writes audit to ledger.
Samir P.: Also recommend masking PII at export time to reduce unwrap frequency (hash emails, mask IPs).
Priya S.: OK I'll post RFC and tag reviewers. Two-week review window requested by Legal (external audit soon).
Legal Team: We'll review once RFC is live.
Priya S.: Adding cleanup task for long-lived grants flagged by security-bot.
Priya S.: Thanks everyone — meeting to follow up after RFC posted.
